name: type-fossil
title: Type Fossil
description: A readable word carries layers of fine contours, revises itself through earlier drafts, then compresses into a clean typographic imprint.
useWhen: A creative process should move from earlier wording to a finished idea.
A title needs a sculptural contour effect that resolves into clean typography.
avoidWhen: Letters must morph individually between phrases: use kinetic-morph-text.
Long paragraphs need to be read: this is built for words and short phrases.
author: Remocn

variables.description: The word the drafts settle on.

variables.label: Drafts
variables.description: Earlier versions, separated by |. Up to twelve; the clip is sized for six, more drafts play faster.
